# mltreelib

> High-performance tree-based machine learning with a pure Rust core (`mltreelib-core`) and thin Python/R interfaces. Specializes in continuous leaf model trees, piecewise linear trees, honest causal uplift trees, multi-factor rotations, anomaly detection, and clustering with zero scikit-learn runtime dependency.

## Core Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/quickstart/): Fast installation, basic model tree fitting, and prediction workflows.
- [Installation](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/installation/): Installing via pip/uv with prebuilt wheels or building from source with Cargo.
- [Tree Architecture & Growth Knobs](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/tree-architecture-and-knobs/): Two-control decoupling, monotone constraints, and honesty fractions.
- [Data Ingestion & Routing](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/data-matrix-and-routing/): Polars/Arrow ingestion, zero-imputation missing routing, and categorical encoders.
- [Metrics, Diagnostics & Calibration](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/guides/metrics-plots/): Gini, ROC/PR curves, Brier calibration, and Population Stability Index (PSI).

## Regression & Continuous Modeling

- [Comprehensive Regression Showcase](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/benchmarks/regression-methods/): 4-study empirical benchmark across physical, heavy-tailed, high-volume, and bounded tabular datasets.
- [Piecewise Linear Trees & Cubist Rules](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/piecewise-linear-and-cubist/): Quinlan M5 model trees, committee rule sets, and k-NN local smoothing.
- [Distributional & Censored Trees](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/distributional-leaves/): Tweedie compound Poisson, Tobit censored splits, and heteroskedastic volatility trees.

## Causal & Unsupervised Learning

- [Causal Uplift Modeling](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/guides/uplift/): Honest causal trees, Athey-Imbens splitting, and Qini evaluation curves.
- [Clustering & Anomaly Trees](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/anomaly-trees/): AnomalyModel (EIF, DET, HST, RCT) and ClusterModel (CLTree, HDBSCAN, PCT, URF).
- [PCA, Factor Analysis & Rotations](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/components-and-rotations/): ComponentModel decomposing continuous features with Varimax and Promax rotations.

## Optimization & Solvers

- [Solvers & Hyperparameter Tuning](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/concepts/solvers-and-optimizers/): 14 standalone optimization solvers, black-box optimizers, CMA-ES, Nelder-Mead, L-BFGS, and AskTell interface.
- [Model Inspection & Rules](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/guides/model-inspection-and-rules/): Quinlan rule extraction, DOT graph visualization, and explainable decision stumps.

## API Reference

- [API Reference Overview](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/reference/api/): Full API documentation for all classes, methods, and functions.
- [ModelTree](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/reference/api/model-tree/): Core tree estimator configuration and methods.
- [AnomalyModel](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/reference/api/anomaly/): Unsupervised anomaly detection facade.
- [ClusterModel](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/reference/api/cluster/): Unsupervised clustering facade.
- [ComponentModel](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/reference/api/components/): Continuous decomposition and factor rotation facade.
- [Solvers](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/reference/api/solvers/): Standalone optimization algorithms.

## How it works

- [Guides overview](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/guides/): task guides, how each mechanism works, and worked examples.
- [TabArena Datasets](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/benchmarks/datasets/): 51 tabular benchmark datasets from OpenML suite 457.
- [Elo Ratings](https://jkapila.github.io/mltreelib/benchmarks/elo/): Head-to-head Elo leaderboards against LightGBM, CatBoost, and XGBoost.
